data.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin correction could be near as traders’ unrealized profit hits 21-month high
data.summary_raw: Bitcoin could face a near-term correction as short-term traders' onchain unrealized profit margin has reached its highest level in 21 months, according to CryptoQuant.

data.title: Comer presses Crypto.com, Hyperliquid and PredictIt on identity checks and suspicious trades
data.summary_raw: Comer’s expanded probe seeks records on government insiders, employee trades and suspicious activity referrals.

data.title: Aztec relaunches zk.money privacy wallet on its Ethereum Layer 2
data.summary_raw: Aztec Labs has relaunched zk.money, a self-custodial privacy wallet, on Aztec Network after discontinuing the original product in 2023.

data.title: Bitcoin tests long-term holder supply cluster as leverage clears, analysts say
data.summary_raw: Bitcoin traded near $84,000 on Tuesday, near Glassnode's largest long-term holder cost-basis cluster price range.
